implemented: The desktop community landing page renders exactly five complete recent-topic cards in one row when at least five topics are available.
The recent-topic selection keeps the newest topic and samples four more topics per page visit while remaining stable for that visit.
All Topics uses document scrolling and bounded twenty-topic batches.
Rendered hashtag labels include a regular space after the hash character.
The public navigation download action is labeled Download in English and 下载 in Simplified Chinese.
The desktop Manual keeps its eyebrow and large title position while moving the document content upward by four pixels.
notPerformed: No production deployment, GitHub Pages workflow dispatch, Alibaba Cloud upload, DNS, TLS, Supabase production configuration, payment configuration, installer, runtime, or release asset was changed.

Ten production community posts were not created because no reusable account password or authenticated trusted-HTTPS session was available to this task. Browser password stores were not inspected and credentials were not guessed.
Software-owned Settings, ECE498, and avatar-crop changes are handled on codex/software and are not included in this website source commit.
